result.rationale: The migration inserts raw setting values verbatim (`INSERT INTO embeddable_hosts (host, ...) VALUES ('#{h}', ...)`) while normalization (`self.host.sub!(/^https?:\/\//, '')`) only runs in `before_validation` on save. The new lookup (`where("lower(host) = ?", host)` against `URI(referer).host`) would not match migrated rows stored with schemes/paths like 'http://discourse.org', so existing configs break after upgrade. Mechanism fully verifiable from the diff.

judged_text: Migrated host values are inserted unnormalized: the migration copies raw setting values like `https://example.com/1234` verbatim into embeddable_hosts.host, but the new lookup compares lower(host) against the bare referer host (URI(referer).host), so any host configured with scheme/path/port silently starts returning 403 after upgrade; normalization only runs before_validation on save, never for migrated rows
